summary: To have the installer sign all service certificates with your own CA, set `aap_ca_cert_file` and `aap_ca_key_file`; if certificates are signed by a custom CA, set `custom_ca_cert`, combining several CA certs into one file.
questions: How do I make AAP use my own CA?
How do I add multiple custom CA certificates to AAP?

answer_card.title: Use your own CA (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
aap_ca_cert_file=<path_to_ca_tls_certificate>
aap_ca_key_file=<path_to_ca_tls_key>
custom_ca_cert=<path_to_custom_ca_certificate>   # one file; concatenate several CAs
```
